profile.summary: I'm a full-stack developer with a background in finance and a firm believer in following my passion in technology.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
+ Build and deploy SSR websites with SEO optimization for AI-based products using Gatsby JS, Docker, and Netlify
+ Collaborate with marketing team and business intelligence team to create new products and strategize plans of action
+ Communicate and collaborate with multiple teams of engineers, designers, producers, clients, and stakeholders daily

positions.title: Student Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lite MeetUp 
A React on Rails application that allows users to interact with each other through events and SMS through Google Map.
+ Developed Rails API back end with self-referential, serializer, active storage and Geocode 
+ Built an interactive map with Google Map API with fuzzy search function
+ Applied Redux to support consistency and flexibility for React 
+ Handled multiple NPM packages while using Git to maintain and manage application on Github  

Lite NekoAtsume 
A React on Rails game like application that allow user to adopt cats through interaction. 
+ Developed Rails API back end to used as database
+ Utilized pop-up modals for entry page 
+ Stylized using canvas to load as a game like interface to feed and adopt online cats

Lite Financial Catculator 
A Javascript on rails application that calculate whether you will be able to retire using a cat as helper.
+ Developed Rails API backend 
+ Implemented financial equations to calculate retirement goal
+ Created user interactivity through bongo cat

positions.title: EIRP Member
positions.description:
+ Engaged in real-world business consulting with actual business and non-profit organizations
+ Solved issues and problems that are of concern to upper level management
+ Provided fresh perspectives on business problems, new ideas for product development or solution of other common and uncommon business challenges

positions.title: Marketing Consultant
positions.description:
+ Developed a customer retention plan through gamification in rising interest rate market.
+ Built an App concept to help Synchrony drive awareness and utilization for existing customers and future prospects.
+ Presented a unique loyalty program to the CEO by benchmarking the competitors and other corporations.

positions.title: Marketing Consultant
positions.description:
+ Indicated action steps along a time-line to engage non-profit sector with for-profit sector through informal partnerships.
+ Established multidimensional social media presence and frequency to increase awareness and earnings. 
+ Modified the professional leadership development and succession planning program to better suit the company.

positions.title: Strategic Alliances Consultant
positions.description:
+ Provided in depth analysis on Blockchain database and how it could help Grant Thornton internally and externally.
+ Presented the flaws and misconceptions of Blockchain technology in the market.
+ Valued acquiring target company using Comparable Analysis.
+ Determined the effect of the acquisition through Accretion/Dilution Analysis.

positions.title: M&A consultant
positions.description:
+ Provided comprehensive analysis on RegTech technology and how it can affect compliance industry.
+ Presented terms for the acquisition and how the acquisition will impact Broadridge using accretion/dilution analysis.
+ Utilized comparable analysis to value the acquiring target company.

positions.title: Book Keeper
positions.description:
Created and maintained inventory data
Input data for check and balances using Quickbooks
Analyzed number in Quickbook to report loss and project where company was heading

positions.title: Marketing Consultant
positions.description:
Developed, planned strategies and campaigns with client in order to improve enrollment
